feedback.generic: Not quite! Study the map and try again.
feedback.teachBothBuckets: Teach the bunny at least {need} berries in each basket first.

success.title: Level complete!
success.gradeMismatchNote: We double-checked this run on our side and updated the result.

teach.trayEmpty: You have taught the bunny with every berry.
teach.guessHeading: New berries — the bunny has never seen these
teach.needMore: Teach it at least {count} safe and {count} unsafe berries, then it will start guessing.
teach.passed: The bunny got them all right! You taught it well.
teach.missed: The bunny got {correct} of {total} right. Teach it a berry that looks like the one it got wrong.
teach.trayHelp: The bunny ate these before, so we know what happened. Pick which ones to teach it with.
teach.guessHelp: These are the mystery berries. The bunny has to work them out from what you taught it.
teach.tryAgain: Not quite yet — teach the bunny a berry like the one it got wrong.
teach.submitFailed: Something went wrong sending that to the bunny. Try pressing Test again.
teach.walk1Body: It has no rule for which berries are safe. You are not going to write one either — there is no code in this level at all.
teach.walk2Body: Each berry here has already been eaten once, so we know what happened. Put some into the baskets. That is all 'teaching' means.
teach.walk3Body: The ? berries are ones it has never seen. To guess, it finds the berry YOU taught it that looks most like the new one, and copies that answer.
teach.walk4Body: If you only ever show it small berries, a big one will look most like the wrong thing — and it will be confidently wrong. Pick examples that cover every kind.
teach.bucketsHelp: Everything you teach it lands here. Click a berry to take it back out.
teach.tooManyExamples: That is {used} examples, and you may only use {max}. Take some back out and pick the ones that teach it the most.

studentsPage.confirmEraseBody: This permanently deletes the account, sign-in and all learning history — progress, attempts, XP, streaks, achievements, hints and teacher feedback. This cannot be undone. Certificates already earned stay valid and publicly verifiable, but no longer show as linked to an active account.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.subtitle: Export everything this school's data looks like, or permanently erase a student's account.
privacyPage.exportBody: A full snapshot of your school's roster, classes and issued certificates — teachers, students, their XP/stars/streaks, class rosters and certificate records. Nothing beyond what's already visible across the Teachers, Students, Classes and Certificates pages, bundled into one download.
privacyPage.exportedNote: Every download is recorded in the audit log with your name and the row counts.
privacyPage.eraseBody: Permanently deleting a student's account and learning history is done from the Students page, next to that student — it needs a typed confirmation because it cannot be undone.
